items.headline: FDA grants first generic approval for twice-yearly HIV prevention shot
items.summary: The FDA gave tentative approval to a generic version of the long-acting HIV prevention injection lenacapavir, made by Dr Reddy's Laboratories. It is expected to cost about forty dollars a year, compared with more than twenty eight thousand dollars for the brand-name version in the United States.
items.why_it_matters: It clears the way for one of the most effective HIV prevention tools to reach around one hundred twenty lower income countries at a small fraction of its original price.
